summary: Hardware compatibility issue with fee calculation module
description: Upon configuring fees and services for a new location linked to an existing merchant ID, the Sales Agent noticed that the settings were missing or not applied. This led to discrepancies in the merchant agreement.
resolution: The database was checked for any existing duplicate merchant IDs. The system was updated to include a validation check to prevent the reoccurrence of duplicate IDs during onboarding.
